pages.title: From the Scabbard
pages.text: Hold Use with a katana in your main hand. Release to sweep in the direction you face. Charging increases damage and reach. Sparks turn blue, violet, then orange. A flash at three seconds marks a full charge.$(br2)From Knowledge II, humanoid lightning dragons can open a close fight with an iai strike.

pages.title: Windstep
pages.text: Windstep lets you reposition faster while charging. You normally move at 40% of your usual speed during a charge. Windstep I, II, and III raise that to 60%, 90%, and 120%.
